description: ADAudit Plus is running at http://localhost:8081/ (login: admin/Admin@2024). Your organization has just deployed ADAudit Plus and you have been tasked with performing a complete enterprise security audit configuration and initial incident response. Specifically: (1) Review the existing audit trail for the past 24 hours and identify the local user account with the highest number of failed logon attempts — this is your primary threat actor; (2) Investigate any file access events in the monitored audit folders to identify which accounts accessed sensitive files; (3) Configure ADAudit Plus for ongoing monitoring by: creating a technician account 'security_ops' (full name 'Security Operations', email 'secops@corp.local', password 'SecOps@2025', role 'Operator'), setting up an email notification profile with threshold-based alerting for any account exceeding 5 failed logons in 10 minutes, and scheduling a daily 'Security Summary' report; (4) Write a comprehensive threat assessment report to C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\threat_assessment.txt that names the specific user accounts involved in suspicious activity, classifies the threat type for each, and provides prioritized remediation steps.
